findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax used in i18next message file
findings.body: In `js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties` line 188, `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. Unlike the Freemarker theme bundles, the `keycloak.v3` account UI and `keycloak.v2` admin UI message bundles are consumed on the frontend by i18next, which uses `{{0}}` interpolation syntax (as seen in all surrounding `error-*` keys in this file) and does not understand Java `MessageFormat` `{0}` placeholders or `{2,choice,...}` expressions. As a result, when this validation error is rendered in the Account UI, the literal placeholders `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}`, and `{2,choice,...}` will be displayed to the user instead of the interpolated values.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax used in i18next admin-ui message file
findings.body: In `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties` line 3138, `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. The `keycloak.v2` admin UI messages are formatted in the browser by i18next, which expects `{{...}}` interpolation and does not support Java `MessageFormat` `{0}` or `{2,choice,...}` syntax. Rendering this error in the Admin UI will output the raw `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}`, and `{2,choice,...}` strings uninterpolated.

findings.title: ANCHOR_PATTERN matches any tag starting with 'a', not just anchor tags
findings.body: In `VerifyMessageProperties.java` line 145, `ANCHOR_PATTERN` is defined as `Pattern.compile("</?a[^>]*>")`. Because there is no word boundary or whitespace/closing-bracket check after `a`, this regex also matches any HTML tag whose name begins with `a` (such as `<abbr>`, `<article>`, `<aside>`, `<audio>`, `<address>`, `<area>`, etc.). Those tags will be treated as anchor tags by `santizeAnchors` instead of being validated by the HTML sanitizer policy, and if they appear in the English source string they would be stripped and bypassed in translations as well.

findings.title: Unescaping HTML entities before and after sanitization allows entity-encoded XSS/HTML injection bypass
findings.body: In `VerifyMessageProperties.java`, `normalizeValue` (line 130) calls `StringEscapeUtils.unescapeHtml4(value)` on the raw property value, and line 95 calls `StringEscapeUtils.unescapeHtml4(sanitized)` on the OWASP sanitizer's output before comparing `sanitized` and `value`. Because OWASP HTML Sanitizer encodes dangerous characters or stripped/disallowed constructs into HTML entities, unescaping both sides means a translation containing entity-encoded HTML (for example `<script>alert(1)</script>` or `<img src=x onerror=...>`) will be unescaped to `<script>alert(1)</script>` in `normalizeValue`, Or if double-encoded (e.g. `&lt;script&gt;`), `normalizeValue` turns it into `<script>`, the OWASP sanitizer leaves `<script>` untouched (or re-encodes `&` to `&lt;`), and `unescapeHtml4(sanitized)` turns it back into `<script>`, matching `value`! Even worse, for single-encoded entities like `<script>` vs `<script>`, if a template or UI component unescapes or renders entities, or if someone puts `<b>` where HTML is disallowed, the interplay of `unescapeHtml4` can mask differences between escaped text and markup.

findings.title: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when value and sanitized have overlapping prefix and suffix
findings.body: In `VerifyMessageProperties.java` lines 102-111, `start` is incremented from the beginning while characters match, and `end` is incremented from the end while characters match, without ensuring `start + end <= Math.min(value.length(), sanitized.length())`. When a string has repeated characters around the difference (for example, `value = "<b><b>"` and `sanitized = "<b>"`), `start` reaches 3 and `end` reaches 3, so `sanitized.length() - end` is `0`, causing `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` on line 111 to throw `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException: begin 3, end 0, length 3` instead of reporting the validation message.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text for totpStep1
findings.body: In `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties` line 101 (and identically in `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties` line 71), the Lithuanian message for `totpStep1` / `loginTotpStep1` was replaced with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian instead of Lithuanian.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese translation replaced with Traditional Chinese text for totpStep1
findings.body: In `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties` line 112, `totpStep1` in the Simplified Chinese (`zh_CN`) bundle was replaced with Traditional Chinese characters (`在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：`) instead of Simplified Chinese (compare with `loginTotpStep1` in `login/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties`: `在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`).
